author: JKawesome
body:
Hey guys!

So, if you've seen the last version of this map, it didn't work out too well. But, I decided to do a complete revamp of it. The old one was more McZone style-ish, with mostly stone bricks. This new one features a futuristic design, with 2 monuments, sniper towers, and a second level in the front of the spawn.









You can view the complete album here: http://imgur.com/a/8rckw#0
The map download is here: http://www.mediafire.com/download/6ydavmyb13j27d6/Orbis.zip
YML can be found here: http://pastebin.com/v6r0A97h
